completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] `provision-streams.sh` called from setup script at correct point in sequence
completion_promises.evidence: Created scripts/setup.sh with a 5-step sequence: (1) validate prerequisites, (2) environment file, (3) docker compose up -d --build, (4) provision-streams.sh, (5) verify-nats.sh. Step 4 calls ./streams/provision-streams.sh after Docker Compose up and health check, and before verification — exactly matching the spec requirement. Tests verify: provision-streams.sh is called (test_calls_provision_streams), it comes after docker compose up (test_provision_after_docker_compose_up), before verify (test_provision_before_verify), is labeled step 4 (test_provision_is_step_4), and the full 5-step sequence exists (test_has_five_steps).

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] `verify-nats.sh` lists all expected streams with `[OK]`/`[MISSING]` status
completion_promises.evidence: Added Check 5 section to scripts/verify-nats.sh that defines EXPECTED_STREAMS='PIPELINE AGENTS JARVIS NOTIFICATIONS SYSTEM FLEET FINPROXY' (all 7 streams from stream-definitions.json), iterates over each with 'nats stream info', and outputs '[OK] STREAM_NAME' or '[MISSING] STREAM_NAME' for each. Also reports summary counts (N found, M missing) and suggests running provision-streams.sh when streams are missing. Tests verify: [OK] and [MISSING] markers exist (test_uses_ok_status_marker, test_uses_missing_status_marker), all 7 individual streams are listed (test_lists_pipeline_stream through test_lists_finproxy_stream), stream list matches stream-definitions.json (test_all_defined_streams_are_checked, test_expected_streams_count_matches), and uses nats stream info with iteration (test_uses_nats_stream_info, test_iterates_over_expected_streams).

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Stream verification is gated on `nats` CLI availability (graceful skip)
completion_promises.evidence: Check 5 in verify-nats.sh is wrapped in 'if has_command nats; then ... else [SKIP] fi' block. When nats CLI is not available, the script outputs '[SKIP] JetStream stream checks — nats CLI not installed' with an install URL, and does not call fail_check (so it doesn't affect exit code). Tests verify: gating on nats CLI (test_check_5_gated_on_nats_cli), graceful SKIP message (test_graceful_skip_when_no_nats_cli), install suggestion (test_skip_suggests_install), no hard failure (test_no_hard_failure_without_nats_cli), and stream check does not affect exit code (test_stream_check_does_not_fail_check).
